version: DoD legislative proposal (8th package, via CRS)
quote: the President may transfer not more than two Virginia class submarines from the inventory of the Navy to the Government of Australia on a sale basis under section 21 of the Arms Export Control Act (22 U.S.C. 2761).
summary: 보유분 2척 이하, AECA 21조 판매. 기한·유예 없음. CNO 인증 면제, 수익은 해군장관 재량.

quote: the President may transfer not more than two Vir- … ginia class submarines from the inventory of the Navy to the Government of Australia on a sale basis under section 21 of the Arms Export Control Act

summary: HASC 보고안에는 판매 승인 없음(sec.518 보고 조항만).
SASC 원안에도 판매 승인 없음(sec.1253 고위관료 지정).

quote: the President is authorized to transfer up to two Virginia Class submarines from the inventory of the Department of the Navy to the Government of Australia on a sale basis, during the 15-year period beginning on the date of the enactment of this Act
summary: 2척, 15년 기간, "Notwithstanding any other provision of law"; 270일 인증 + 불승인 공동결의.

quote: transfer not more than two Virginia class submarines from the inventory of the United States Navy to the Government of Australia on a sale basis; and … transfer not more than one additional Virginia class submarine to the Government of Australia on a sale basis.
summary: 처음으로 "2척 + 추가 1척" 구조 등장(현존 문서 기준). 60일 전 인증, MDA 전제, 추가판매 별도입법.

quote: Not less than 60 days prior to transferring one or more Virginia class submarines from the inventory of the United States Navy to the Government of Australia
summary: 판매 승인 아님 — 이전 시 인증 조건만. Div. F Title LXVIII에는 훈련 조항(6823)만.

quote: the President is authorized to transfer up to two Virginia Class submarines from the inventory of the Department of the Navy to the Government of Australia on a sale basis, during the 15-year period beginning on the date of the enactment of this Act
summary: 수량·기간은 IH와 동일; 인증요건 일부 수정(HEU "stockpiles"), 기여금 계정(sec.4) 추가.

quote: the President is authorized to transfer up to two Virginia Class submarines from the inventory of the Department of the Navy to the Government of Australia on a sale basis, and transfer not more than one additional Virginia Class submarine
summary: 2(보유분)+1(추가), 1년 유예, 20년 기간, AECA 36조·10 USC 8677 배제, 270일 인증, MDA 전제.

quote: Effective beginning on the date that is one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the President is authorized to transfer up to two Virginia Class submarines from the inventory of the Department of the Navy to the Government of Australia on a sale basis, and transfer not more than one additional Virginia Class submarine to the Government of Australia on a sale basis pursuant to section 21 of the Arms Export Control Act
